answer: Only 49% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not pay. Because the delta ledger attributes every share, the raven audit shows the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, thus it burns the willow fee twice and still divides one payout. The fee repeats 27 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
